source_method.retrieval: Lead extracts and page/revision metadata were fetched from MDWiki. Definitions are the first source sentence (occasionally two when the first is unusually short); summaries preserve source wording and are limited to complete sentences up to 350 words. Whitespace was normalized for readable JSON. No unsupported clinical claims were added.

license_verification.result: The current full license body identifies CC BY-SA 4.0 International. The page states CC BY-SA 3.0 and 4.0 in its heading; the current body was checked by the coordinating agent.

source_method.attribution: Every article record links to its MDWiki page, specific revision, and page history. Some source text may be mirrored; no speculative original Wikipedia revision link is included when the retrieved article data did not identify one.
source_method.additional_method: For source pages whose extracts endpoint returned missing/no extract, action=parse was used to render the article. Intro paragraphs were extracted as text before the first level-2/3 heading, skipping table/list/figure/script/style/reference-citation content and hidden short descriptions. Where MDWiki marked the source revision as mirrored, its revision ID was verified against the English Wikipedia API and records link to the exact original revision, article, and contributor history. No raw HTML is stored.
